values.title: What judo gives – and what stays.
values.lead: Judo is more than a sport. It is an attitude that children and adults carry into everyday life.

items.title: Respect
items.text: Every session begins and ends with a bow. Respect for your partner, for the coach – and for yourself.

items.title: Discipline
items.text: Progress comes from repetition. We practise patience, keep showing up and celebrate the small steps too.

items.title: Confidence
items.text: Learning how to fall takes away the fear of falling. That feeling carries far beyond the mat.

items.title: Community
items.text: We train with each other, not against each other. When it gets tough, the group carries you.

programs.title: The right start at every age
programs.lead: From the first forward roll to the first standing throw: we guide you step by step – no pressure, but with clear structure.

items.title: Judo Kids
items.text: Playful judo: rolling, falling, first throws – and a lot of joy in movement.

meta.title: About us – ATAI JUDO ACADEMY, judo school in Abu Dhabi
meta.description: From Germany to Abu Dhabi: the story of the ATAI JUDO ACADEMY, our values and our goals.

hero.title: A judo school that passes on values.
hero.lead: From Germany to Abu Dhabi: the ATAI JUDO ACADEMY grew out of the belief that judo accompanies you for life.

story.title: A passion project, 5,000 kilometres from home
paragraphs: Mohamed Charrak learned judo in Germany from the ground up: as an athlete, as a coach and as a referee. A few years ago he moved to Abu Dhabi – and opened his own school there, the ATAI JUDO ACADEMY.

In Abu Dhabi, judo is not yet as deeply rooted as in Germany. That is exactly where the opportunity lies: many families are only just discovering the sport. When parents see how calmly and attentively their children work on the mat, they are delighted.
Today a large part of our children's groups are girls – around 30 per cent. For us that is not a detail, but a sign that judo has arrived here.

philosophy.title: Technique beats strength
paragraphs: Judo thrives on timing, balance and the right grip – not on raw strength. That is exactly what our judoka learn from the very first session: grip with control, turn cleanly, land safely.
And the fun never falls by the wayside. Those who see progress stay with it – and those who stay get better.
philosophy.quote: Judo is a school for life.

items.title: Grow the groups
items.text: We are expanding training times, age groups and classes – at a pace that does not put quality at risk.

items.title: Competition experience
items.text: Our goal: to compete at the UAE national championship with one of our talents.

items.title: Good coaching
items.text: We keep learning, work with guest coaches and keep our methodology up to date.

meta.title: Judo training in Abu Dhabi – groups, times and how to start
meta.description: Judo for children from 5, teenagers and adults in Abu Dhabi: training times, groups and everything you need for your first session.

hero.title: Training that grows with you
hero.lead: Small groups, clear structure and coaches who see every bit of progress – from the first roll to the first throw.

groups.title: Three groups, one goal
groups.lead: Every group has its own rhythm. You can join any group at any time.

firstSteps.title: How to get started
firstSteps.lead: You need no previous experience and no equipment. Just come along.

items.title: Arrive 15 minutes early
items.text: That leaves time to settle in, get changed and ask your first questions.

items.title: Sportswear is enough
items.text: Long sports trousers and a T-shirt are fine for a trial session. We will lend you a judogi.

items.title: Barefoot on the mat
items.text: Shoes stay at the edge of the mat. Please come with clean feet and short fingernails.

items.title: Questions are welcome
items.text: If anything is unclear, just ask – that is what the first session is for.

items.a: Not for the trial session. Afterwards we recommend your own gi – we will advise you on size and quality.

items.q: From what age can children start?
items.a: Our children's group starts at five. For the youngest, movement and play come first.
Yes, parents are welcome. We just ask you to stay at the edge of the mat and not to interrupt the session.
Judo is one of the safest martial arts. Breakfalls, controlled techniques and qualified supervision come first with us.

items.q: Can I start as an adult?
items.a: At any time. Our adult group is open to beginners and returners – with no pressure to perform.
The cost depends on the group. Talk to us – we will explain everything calmly and without obligation.

hero.title: People who live judo.
hero.lead: A coach who comes from Germany – and a school that benefits from his experience.

founder.name: Mohamed Charrak
founder.text: Mohamed Charrak grew up in Germany as a judoka, coach and referee. Today he lives in Abu Dhabi, where he has built his own school: the ATAI JUDO ACADEMY. His standard is simple – clean technique, respectful interaction and training that benefits everyone.

philosophy.title: Three things that shape every session

items.title: Technique before strength
items.text: We explain why a movement works – and practise it until it feels secure.

items.title: Patience instead of pressure
items.text: Nobody has to improve quickly. Everyone may learn at their own pace.

items.title: Respect as the foundation
items.text: We greet each other, we help each other, we look out for each other.

join.title: Would you like to be part of the team?
join.text: We are growing – and looking for coaches and helpers who enjoy working with children and adults. Judo experience is welcome, but not a requirement for every role.
